title: Compatibility catalog: maintain tokenization, context, and tooling parity for fallback variants
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and maintain a machine-readable compatibility catalog that tracks tokenizer behavior, maximum context window, and critical tooling parity (streaming, function-calls, embeddings input conventions) across primary models and their fallback variants. The catalog will be the source-of-truth used by smart routing to decide safe fallbacks when region/tier capacity is constrained and will power runtime checks and automated mitigation suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical JSON catalog schema exists and is checked into repo (catalog schema versioned)

Catalog contains entries for primary + fallback variants for top 30 most-used models in production with tokenizer fingerprint, max_context, and boolean flags for streaming/function-calls/embeddings compatibility
Runtime reads catalog to make deterministic fallback decisions in the routing layer for regional and tiered policies
Automated nightly validation job runs against model containers to detect drift and writes a report to the console dashboard
Documentation (README + example routing policy) and an SDK helper (Python) for querying catalog are published
tasks: Design catalog schema (fields: model_id, variant_id, tokenizer_hash, tokenizer_name, max_context, supports_streaming, supports_function_calls, embeddings_input_style, known_token_offset_diffs)
Implement generator harness that loads model artifacts and computes tokenizer fingerprint and max context (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/8921)
Add runtime integration: routing layer reads catalog and falls back only to catalog-marked compatible variants
Create nightly CI job (infra) to re-run generator against tiled images and post results to /console/catalog-validation
Backfill catalog for top-30 models from model registry and attach source links
Add unit and integration tests for fallback decision logic (simulate mismatch scenarios)
updates: 2026-03-01 - Ticket created by Aisha. Initial scope defined to cover tokenizer + context + streaming/function-calls parity. Recommended schema with boolean tooling flags.
2026-03-05 - Spike completed: tokenizer fingerprinting approach using BPE/vocab+merges hash validated on internal models. Prototype script produces consistent fingerprints across container variants.
2026-03-09 - Design review with PM (Sofia Nguyen) and Runtime leads. Decided to require explicit 'supports_function_calls' flag instead of relying on heuristic. Marco assigned to implement generator.
2026-03-12 - PR #8921 opened (generator harness). Early review feedback: add metric emission for max_context detection and handle tokenizers that report variable contexts.

2026-03-14 - Integration plan drafted: runtime will consult catalog during routing decision; fallback blocked if tokenizer_hash mismatch and 'known_token_offset_diffs' exceeds threshold. Nightly job scheduled in infra cycle.
notes: Trade-offs: strict compatibility checks reduce likelihood of silent tokenization/regression issues but may reduce available fallbacks under capacity pressure. To mitigate, we'll add an operator-visible tolerance override and an automated verification run that attempts a small set of customer prompt families against fallback candidates.
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Nguyen): Ensure catalog surfaces human-readable explanation fields for on-call and SRE to quickly understand mitigation steps.
Design: Add UX hook in Console to show why a fallback was rejected (tokenizer mismatch / missing tooling) + suggested substitutes.
Security: Confirm PR artifacts don't expose model weights. Generator will only read tokenizer metadata and emit fingerprints; security approved the approach in principle.
